description: Static code analysis of navigation and job persistence. Tests are pass/fail assertions derived from reading CreateScreen.tsx, App.tsx, and api-server/src/index.ts. No live runtime execution.

legend.PASS_BEFORE_FIX: Already correct before this change set
legend.FAIL_BEFORE_FIX: Broken before; root cause identified in code
legend.NEEDS_MANUAL_REVIEW: Cannot be verified without a running Unity device or network simulation

step1_back_navigation.description: Start generation, wait 5s, press back — job appears in Create tab as 'generating'
step1_back_navigation.navigation_path: prompt → forge() → EditorScreen (5s) → back button → prompt
step1_back_navigation.expected_state_on_return: game card visible with hasCode=false and 'Generating...' subtitle
step1_back_navigation.root_cause_before_fix: onBack called setBuildJobId(''), cleared the jobId. EditorScreen unmounted, polling useEffect cleanup fired, all intervals cancelled. loadMyGames() refetched from Supabase returning hasCode=false, but no polling loop was started to detect completion.
step1_back_navigation.fix_applied: Removed setBuildJobId('') from onBack. Added prompt-phase polling useEffect that iterates _jobCache. _jobCache.set(gameId, jobId) in forge() so the jobId is never lost.

step1_back_navigation.description: Start generation, press back immediately (under 1 second) — job not lost
step1_back_navigation.navigation_path: prompt → forge() → EditorScreen (<1s) → back button → prompt
step1_back_navigation.root_cause_before_fix: Same as S1-01 — immediate back press hits the same code path

step1_back_navigation.description: Press back at exactly script_ready transition — game appears as playable
step1_back_navigation.navigation_path: prompt → forge() → EditorScreen (waits for script_ready) → back → prompt
step1_back_navigation.expected_state_on_return: game card with hasCode=true, Play button visible
step1_back_navigation.analysis: At script_ready the server saves game_code to Supabase. loadMyGames() fetches it and returns hasCode=true. This worked even before the fix because Supabase is queried synchronously on back press.
step1_back_navigation.fix_applied: No change needed for this case. Prompt-phase polling also detects script_ready and updates hasCode=true within 3 seconds as a belt-and-suspenders.

step1_back_navigation.description: Press back at exactly done transition — completed game appears
step1_back_navigation.navigation_path: prompt → forge() → EditorScreen (waits for done) → back → prompt
step1_back_navigation.expected_state_on_return: game card with hasCode=true, full title/genre visible
step1_back_navigation.analysis: At done, Supabase has full data. loadMyGames() returns it correctly.
step1_back_navigation.fix_applied: Prompt-phase polling also clears _jobCache on done so no orphan poll continues.

step1_back_navigation.description: Navigate back and immediately forward again — no duplicate job cards
step1_back_navigation.navigation_path: prompt → forge() → editor → back → prompt → editor
step1_back_navigation.expected_state_on_return: single card per game, no duplicates
step1_back_navigation.analysis: forge() uses setMyGames(prev => [stub, ...prev.filter(x => x.id !== gameId)]). loadMyGames() replaces the full list from Supabase. Prompt-phase polling updates via prev.map (keyed on id, never appends). Deduplication is guaranteed.
step1_back_navigation.fix_applied: No change needed. Confirmed in new code: all setMyGames calls in polling use .map or .filter keyed on id.

step1_back_navigation.description: Navigate back, wait 60s, return to Create tab — job has continued generating
step1_back_navigation.navigation_path: prompt → forge() → editor → back → (wait 60s) → Create tab selected
step1_back_navigation.expected_state_on_return: card reflects current server state (still generating or completed)
step1_back_navigation.root_cause_before_fix: CreateScreen stays mounted through back navigation (App only unmounts on tab switch), so after 60s the prompt-phase polling now runs. But if the user had switched tabs during those 60s, the old code would have lost the jobId.
step1_back_navigation.before_fix: PASS_BEFORE_FIX (if never left Create tab); FAIL_BEFORE_FIX (if switched tabs)
step1_back_navigation.fix_applied: Module-level _jobCache persists jobId across tab switches. On CreateScreen remount, polling effect immediately reads _jobCache and resumes.

step1_back_navigation.description: Navigate back, wait until generation fully completes, return — completed game shown correctly
step1_back_navigation.navigation_path: prompt → forge() → editor → back → (wait until done) → check list
step1_back_navigation.expected_state_on_return: card with hasCode=true, correct title, genre
step1_back_navigation.fix_applied: New prompt-phase polling detects done status, updates myGames via id-keyed map.

step2_tab_switch.description: Switch to another tab mid-generation — job continues server-side
step2_tab_switch.analysis: Server generation is always async and independent of client connectivity. This was always true.

step2_tab_switch.description: Return to Create tab after tab switch — polling resumes, card updates live
step2_tab_switch.navigation_path: Create → forge() → EditorScreen → switch to Play tab → switch back to Create
step2_tab_switch.root_cause_before_fix: App.tsx uses {tab === 2 && <CreateScreen/>}. Switching tabs unmounts CreateScreen, destroying all useState including buildJobId. On remount, loadMyGames runs but finds no jobId to poll.
step2_tab_switch.fix_applied: _jobCache is module-level; survives unmount. On remount, loadMyGames detects hasCode=false games and re-populates _jobCache via the new /api/forge-game/find-by-game/:gameId endpoint if _jobCache is empty. Prompt-phase polling effect then starts automatically.

step2_tab_switch.description: Switch tabs 5 times rapidly — no duplicate jobs
step2_tab_switch.analysis: Each remount of CreateScreen: loadMyGames replaces myGames from Supabase (no append). Polling updates via id-keyed map. _jobCache is a Map (duplicate keys impossible).

step2_tab_switch.description: Play another game while generating — independent operations
step2_tab_switch.analysis: Game play is via Globals.loadGame() (C# bridge), completely independent of the forge-game HTTP flow.

step3_app_backgrounding.description: Background app briefly (30s) and return — job continues
step3_app_backgrounding.analysis: iOS/Android suspend but don't kill short-backgrounded apps. Unity's C# layer and React state survive. Server runs independently.
step3_app_backgrounding.notes: Requires device testing. Expected: PASS on iOS (app survives 30s background).

step3_app_backgrounding.description: Background 3 minutes — completed game shown on return
step3_app_backgrounding.analysis: App may be killed in 3 min on low-memory devices. If alive, polling resumes normally. If killed, falls back to S4 (app relaunch) behavior.

step3_app_backgrounding.description: Background/foreground 10 times rapidly — no memory leaks, no duplicate polling
step3_app_backgrounding.analysis: All useEffect hooks return cleanup functions that clearInterval. Module-level _jobCache is a Map so inserting the same gameId twice has no effect. React re-mounts call the same effect with the same cleanup contract.
step3_app_backgrounding.fix_applied: New prompt-phase polling effect also returns clearInterval cleanup. Verified in code.

step4_app_kill_relaunch.description: Force-kill during generation, relaunch — pending job appears
step4_app_kill_relaunch.analysis: On relaunch: _jobCache is empty (process restart). loadMyGames fetches from Supabase returning the game with hasCode=false. Then calls /api/forge-game/find-by-game/:gameId. If the server is still running and the job is within its 45-min TTL, the server returns the jobId. Polling starts.
step4_app_kill_relaunch.fix_applied: Added GET /api/forge-game/find-by-game/:gameId on server. loadMyGames now calls this for every hasCode=false game after fetching from Supabase.
step4_app_kill_relaunch.after_fix: PASS_AFTER_FIX (when server is still running with live job)

step4_app_kill_relaunch.description: Force-kill at script_ready, relaunch — game shown as playable
step4_app_kill_relaunch.analysis: At script_ready server has already written game_code to Supabase. On relaunch, loadMyGames returns hasCode=true for this game. No poll needed.

step4_app_kill_relaunch.description: Force-kill at done, relaunch — completed game shown
step4_app_kill_relaunch.analysis: Full data in Supabase. loadMyGames returns it correctly.

step4_app_kill_relaunch.description: Force-kill during Meshy generation, relaunch — asset loading resumes not restarts
step4_app_kill_relaunch.analysis: Server continues Meshy generation independently of client. Job is in script_ready state. On relaunch: hasCode=true from Supabase (game is already playable). If server finds the job via find-by-game, prompt-phase polling tracks assets completing. No restart from scratch.

step4_app_kill_relaunch.description: After relaunch, app reads from Supabase not local state
step4_app_kill_relaunch.analysis: loadMyGames() always calls fetchMyGamesFromSupabase() unconditionally on mount. Local _jobCache is used only as a secondary hint for poll recovery, not for display state.

step5_concurrent_jobs.description: Start 2 game generations simultaneously — both appear as separate cards
step5_concurrent_jobs.analysis: Each forge() call adds a stub to myGames with a unique id, and adds to _jobCache. Prompt-phase polling iterates all _jobCache entries. Both cards show independently.
step5_concurrent_jobs.before_fix: FAIL_BEFORE_FIX (buildJobId could only track one job; second forge would overwrite it in state)
step5_concurrent_jobs.fix_applied: _jobCache is a Map keyed by gameId — supports N concurrent jobs. Prompt-phase polling iterates all entries.
step5_concurrent_jobs.caveat: EditorScreen can only display one active build at a time. Starting a second forge while in EditorScreen is blocked (setPhase resets to prompt or a new editor is opened). The prompt-phase polling handles both background jobs correctly.

step5_concurrent_jobs.description: Meshy semaphore (10 max) throttles assets across concurrent jobs without starvation
step5_concurrent_jobs.analysis: meshySem is a FIFO Semaphore(10) in api-server. Each asset resolve() call calls meshySem.run(). Assets from all jobs share the same semaphore pool. This was already implemented correctly before this change.

step5_concurrent_jobs.description: Complete one job while other is still generating — no cross-contamination
step5_concurrent_jobs.analysis: Polling loop: done status removes only that gameId from _jobCache. setMyGames updates only the matching card via id-keyed .map(). Other cards unaffected.
step5_concurrent_jobs.fix_applied: New prompt-phase polling with id-keyed updates

step6_create_tab_state.description: Create tab refetches games list every time it mounts
step6_create_tab_state.analysis: useEffect(() => { loadMyGames(); }, []) runs on every mount. Since App.tsx unmounts/remounts CreateScreen on tab switch, this runs every time the Create tab is selected.

step6_create_tab_state.description: In-progress jobs polled at correct interval while Create tab is visible
step6_create_tab_state.analysis: New prompt-phase polling runs every 3000ms when phase === 'prompt'. EditorScreen polling runs every 2500ms during active build.
step6_create_tab_state.fix_applied: New 3s polling loop in prompt-phase useEffect

step6_create_tab_state.description: Polling stops when Create tab is unmounted
step6_create_tab_state.analysis: The prompt-phase useEffect returns () => clearInterval(interval). When CreateScreen unmounts (tab switch), React runs this cleanup. No orphan intervals.
step6_create_tab_state.before_fix: PASS_BEFORE_FIX (EditorScreen polls cleaned up); FAIL_BEFORE_FIX (no prompt-phase poll existed to leak)
step6_create_tab_state.fix_applied: New prompt-phase polling effect has explicit clearInterval() cleanup

step6_create_tab_state.description: Polling resumes correctly when Create tab remounts
Create tab never shows stale completed state for in-progress job
step6_create_tab_state.analysis: On mount, loadMyGames() replaces myGames from Supabase (source of truth). The polling effect updates via Supabase-sourced status checks every 3s. Stale local-only state is overwritten on every mount.

step6_create_tab_state.description: Jobs deleted from Supabase while tracked locally — clean error state
step6_create_tab_state.analysis: On next loadMyGames(), the game won't appear in the Supabase result. setMyGames replaces the full list, so the card disappears. If the _jobCache still has an entry, the polling will 404 and the loop silently moves on (catch {} swallows it). Card is already gone from UI.

step6_create_tab_state.description: Job cards ordered: most recently created first
step6_create_tab_state.analysis: fetchMyGamesFromSupabase appends order=created_at.desc to the Supabase query. forge() inserts new stubs at the head of myGames with [stub, ...prev.filter(...)]. Both paths are consistent.

step7_state_transitions.analysis: EditorScreen polls every 2500ms. Prompt-phase polling runs every 3000ms. Worst-case latency: 3s from transition to UI update.

step7_state_transitions.description: Job never skips script_ready → directly done
step7_state_transitions.analysis: Server code: jobs.set(jobId, {status:'script_ready',...}) always runs before jobs.set(jobId, {status:'done',...}). Enforced by sequential async/await in runForgeGame().

step7_state_transitions.description: Job never regresses from done back to script_ready/pending
step7_state_transitions.analysis: Server state machine is write-forward only. No code path writes a lower state after done.

step7_state_transitions.description: Job stuck in pending >5min — client surfaces timeout error
step7_state_transitions.before_fix: FAIL_BEFORE_FIX (no client timeout existed; polling ran forever)
step7_state_transitions.fix_applied: New prompt-phase polling tracks each job's age via jobStartTimes Map. After JOB_TIMEOUT_MS (5 min), removes from _jobCache and updates the card description to 'Generation timed out — please try again.'
step7_state_transitions.notes: EditorScreen chat still shows the perpetual 'Building...' spinner while the user is in editor view. Server-side timeout enhancement is a follow-up: mark job as error in Supabase if pending >5min (not yet implemented here).

step7_state_transitions.description: Job stuck in script_ready >5min — UI shows partial completion with playable message
step7_state_transitions.analysis: When script_ready is detected: hasCode is set to true (game is playable). The Generating/asset-loading message continues in EditorScreen chat. After 5min client timeout, the card transitions from 'Generating...' to the complete state since hasCode=true. User can play.
step7_state_transitions.fix_applied: Prompt-phase polling sets hasCode=true on script_ready, making the card playable. Client timeout only fires for pending state; script_ready is not timedout since the game is already usable.

step7_state_transitions.description: Server error on job — UI shows clear error state on card, not forever-spinner
step7_state_transitions.before_fix: FAIL_BEFORE_FIX (EditorScreen showed error in chat; prompt-phase card showed 'Generating...' forever)
step7_state_transitions.fix_applied: Prompt-phase polling detects r.status==='error', removes from _jobCache, updates description to the server error message in red.

step7_state_transitions.description: All state transitions persisted to Supabase immediately
step7_state_transitions.analysis: Server code: sbPatch() called at script_ready (saves game_code, title, etc.) and at done (saves asset_urls_json). Both calls are non-blocking fire-and-forget with catch logging.

step8_deep_link.description: Deep link / direct URL navigation while generating
step8_deep_link.analysis: Pludo is a Unity WebGL/mobile app with no URL-based routing. The React layer uses tab indices and phase state, not URLs. Deep linking is not applicable to the current architecture.
step8_deep_link.notes: If a web build with URL routing is added in future, this section needs re-evaluation.

step9_network_failure.description: Network cut for 10s then restored — polling recovers
step9_network_failure.analysis: All poll fetch calls are wrapped in try/catch. Failed polls are silently skipped. On reconnect, the next scheduled poll succeeds and updates state.

step9_network_failure.description: Network cut until completion, then restored — Create tab shows completed game immediately
step9_network_failure.analysis: On next successful poll after restore, r.status==='done' fires and updates the card. No delay beyond one poll interval (3s).
step9_network_failure.before_fix: PASS_BEFORE_FIX (if EditorScreen was open); FAIL_BEFORE_FIX (if in prompt phase)
step9_network_failure.fix_applied: Prompt-phase polling handles done state on reconnect

step9_network_failure.description: API server unreachable — UI shows connection error rather than silent failure
step9_network_failure.fix_applied: Prompt-phase polling increments retryDelay on catch (exponential backoff to 30s max). No explicit error card shown on connection failure — the card stays 'Generating...' until reconnect. This is acceptable behavior for transient outages.
step9_network_failure.after_fix: PARTIAL — exponential backoff implemented; explicit 'connection error' card not shown. NEEDS_MANUAL_REVIEW if a hard UI error is required.

step9_network_failure.description: Failed poll requests retried with exponential backoff
step9_network_failure.fix_applied: retryDelay variable in prompt-phase polling doubles on each catch, caps at 30s, resets to 3s on success. Note: the setInterval itself is still fixed at 3s; the backoff only affects when we skip processing (a minor limitation — full backoff would require dynamic interval, which adds complexity).
step9_network_failure.after_fix: PARTIAL — see note above. True exponential backoff with dynamic interval is a follow-up improvement.
step9_network_failure.notes: NEEDS_MANUAL_REVIEW for full backoff behavior validation.

state_transition_log_schema.description: Schema for runtime state transition logging (requires actual execution)
state_transition_log_schema.note: Populate this at runtime by adding console.log statements to the polling effects and the server's jobs.set() calls.

key_fixes: Module-level _jobCache (gameId→jobId Map) survives component unmounts caused by tab switches
Removed setBuildJobId('') from onBack — job tracking continues in background
New prompt-phase polling loop in CreateScreen iterates _jobCache every 3s
Client-side 5min timeout marks stuck-pending jobs as timed-out with red error text
New GET /api/forge-game/find-by-game/:gameId endpoint enables app-relaunch job recovery
loadMyGames() now calls find-by-game for every hasCode=false game after Supabase fetch
Error cards surface server error messages in red; timeout cards show human-readable message
Exponential backoff (3s→30s) on network failure in prompt-phase polling
